data.name: Dead Party
data.detailed_description:
On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood rises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders! 

Dead Party is a co-op Party Action Game where players work together to defend their bases from a zombie invasion. Play through the Story Mode to experience the character’s adventures as they fight the zombie apocalypse with the power of rock music, or jump straight into the action in the customizable Arcade Mode. 

Team up with Friends to Defend Against Approaching Zombies

Team up in a party of 4 to fight off the approaching zombie horde. Defend buildings from zombies in 4 distinct game modes. Fight back zombies with the power of music in the Showtime game mode, power generators to send out jamming radio waves in the Fuel Run game mode, and collect the skulls of zombies to shoot UFOs out of the sky in the Skull Cannon mode. Finally, test your endurance in the Horde mode, and see how long you can survive before being overrun!

Use Whatever you Find to Build Blockades to Keep the Zombies Outside

Break furniture and objects to collect resources to put up barricades and slow the advance of zombies. Play through multiple levels with unique layouts, and learn the various chokepoints to figure out the best strategy to keep the zombies at bay.

Improvise Crazy Traps and Find Weapons to Fight Back Intruders

Unlock crazy traps and powerful weapons to fight back against zombies that get past your barricades. Battle against different types of zombies, each with their own mechanics, and find the best approach to repel each intruder. The invaders also have one major weakness: they cannot withstand human music! When surrounded, each character can use the power of their guitars to repel the enemy.

Rock out with Special Abilities, Skills and Character Storylines to Follow

Follow the storylines of 4 unique characters as they battle through the zombie apocalypse, and deal with it in their own ways. Each character has different strengths and weaknesses, abilities, and perks that can be gained through unlocked equipment.
